entries.1c36c5a026a76f84: This category undertakes development of services and systems for customers. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥125 million.
entries.26eee92b794c0232: Service providers that receive licenses for databases and systems
entries.2c979c37fe2e4dbd: This category provides the company's own databases and systems as licenses and also operates the services it develops. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥934 million.
entries.8f17731e0debccd5: A company that develops databases systematizing sensibility data such as music and video, and provides businesses with data services such as recommendation and search.
entries.d9b00b632848097e: This is a single-segment business that develops databases on entertainment such as music, video, books and people, and on everyday life such as beauty, food, beverages, clothing and travel, and combines them with Kansei metadata that systematizes sensibilities and emotions to provide data provision, recommendation, personalization, search and data analytics (data analysis) services. It currently runs three businesses: Music Data Service, Video Data Service and Kansei Targeted Advertising Service. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,060 million.
